description: A version is proposed only once it has been public for two days, so that a release pulled or fixed in its first days never reaches a branch. internalChecksFilter is already strict by default; it is stated so that the wait is read here as holding back the branch and the pull request themselves, not only a status check on them

packageRules.description: Patch, digest and pin updates are merged by Renovate itself once the pull request's checks pass. They are the updates that are not meant to change behaviour, and the weekly release picks them up as a patch release. Merging is left to Renovate rather than to GitHub's auto-merge, which this repository does not enable and whose settings are not changed for this. Minor and major updates only open a pull request
A new Go minor in the go directive raises the Go every user of go install needs, and CI follows it through go-version-file. It waits for approval on the dashboard; patches flow as usual

Workflows are already read by the github-actions manager. Grouping them keeps a handful of actions from arriving as a handful of pull requests, since they are updated together and reviewed the same way

The official ubuntu image is proposed without the two-day wait. Docker Hub gives a tag's last push as its release time, and the official ubuntu tags are pushed again every day or two, so a tag seldom looks two days old and an update would hardly ever be proposed. sdctl does not use the image today; the rule is kept so that this file matches the other repositories and the image is not held back once it is used. The name is matched as it is written, not as Docker Hub resolves it, so each way of writing the image is listed. The pull request's checks still have to pass
